recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut in strips
3 bell peppers in different colors, sliced
Sour cream, guacamole, salsa and shredded cheese
steps: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion. Ask an adult to help, and wash your hands after the chicken.
Mix the spices and salt and toss half with the chicken and 1 tablespoon oil.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the peppers and onion with the rest of the spices for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft and charred. Move to a plate.
Add the last of the oil and cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until 165°F (74°C) inside.
Add the vegetables back and squeeze the lime over everything.
Warm the tortillas and fill them with fajita mix and toppings.

recipes.name: Steak fajitas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) skirt or flank steak
Guacamole, pico de gallo and sour cream
steps: Mix the lime juice, 2 tablespoons oil, garlic, spices and salt and coat the steak. Marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes to 4 hours.
Slice the peppers and onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat a big heavy pan over high heat and cook the steak for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 135°F (57°C) for medium. Rest for 10 minutes.
Add the rest of the oil and cook the peppers and onion for 6 to 8 minutes, until charred.
Slice the steak thinly across the grain.
Serve in warm tortillas with the vegetables and toppings.

recipes.name: Red chicken enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can (4 oz / 115 g) diced green chilies
3 cups (720 ml) red enchilada sauce, divided
2 1/2 cups (250 g) shredded Monterey Jack or cheddar, divided
Sour cream, cilantro and sliced green onion to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the chicken, green chilies, cumin, 1/2 cup of sauce and 1 cup of cheese.
Spread 1/2 cup of sauce in the bottom of a 9 by 13 inch dish.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave for 30 seconds to soften.
Fill each tortilla with chicken, roll up and lay seam side down in the dish.
Pour the rest of the sauce over and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbly. Top with sour cream and cilantro.

recipes.name: Cheese enchiladas
ingredients: 3 cups (300 g) shredded cheddar and Monterey Jack
Sour cream and shredded lettuce to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Chop the onion.
Warm the sauce in a pan. Brush the tortillas with oil and microwave them in a damp towel for 30 seconds.
Spread 1/2 cup of sauce in a 9 by 13 inch dish.
Dip each tortilla in the warm sauce, fill with 3 tablespoons of cheese and a little onion, and roll up.
Lay them seam side down, pour the rest of the sauce over, and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until bubbly. Serve with sour cream and lettuce.

recipes.name: Ground beef enchiladas
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) pinto or black beans, drained
3 cups (720 ml) red enchilada sauce, divided
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Chop the onion.
Cook the beef and onion over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Stir in the spices, salt, beans and 1/2 cup sauce.
Spread 1/2 cup sauce in a 9 by 13 inch dish.
Fill each tortilla with beef and a little cheese, roll up and lay seam side down.
Pour the rest of the sauce over and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbly.

recipes.name: Chicken tinga
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
2 to 3 chipotle peppers in adobo, plus 1 tablespoon adobo sauce
Tostadas or tortillas, crema, avocado and queso fresco
steps: Simmer the chicken in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes, until 165°F (74°C). Shred it.
Slice the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Blend the tomatoes, chipotles, adobo, garlic, oregano and broth until smooth.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 6 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and salt and simmer for 5 minutes, until saucy.
Pile onto tostadas or into tortillas with crema, avocado and queso fresco.

recipes.name: Slow cooker carnitas
ingredients: 4 lb (1.8 kg) boneless pork shoulder, cut in 3 inch chunks
Corn tortillas, chopped onion, cilantro and salsa verde
steps: Rub the pork with the salt, cumin, oregano and pepper. Wash your hands.
Put the onion and garlic in the slow cooker, add the pork and pour the juices over.
Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, until it falls apart.
Shred the pork with two forks.
Heat the oven broiler. Ask an adult to help.
Spread the pork on a baking sheet, drizzle with 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid, and broil for 4 to 5 minutes, until the edges crisp. Watch closely.
Serve in warm tortillas with onion, cilantro and salsa.

recipes.name: Carne asada
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) skirt or flank steak
Tortillas, onion, cilantro, lime and salsa
steps: Chop the jalapeno and cilantro. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the juices, oil, garlic, jalapeno, cilantro, cumin and salt.
Coat the steak and marinate in the fridge for 2 hours to overnight.
Heat a grill or grill pan over high heat. An adult should do the grilling.
Cook the steak for 4 to 6 minutes per side, until 135°F (57°C) for medium.
Rest for 10 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain and chop.
Serve in tortillas with onion, cilantro, lime and salsa.

recipes.name: Slow cooker beef barbacoa
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) beef chuck roast, cut in 4 chunks
steps: Rub the beef with the salt and put it in the slow cooker.
Blend the broth, chipotles, lime juice, vinegar, garlic, cumin, oregano and cloves until smooth.
Pour it over the beef and tuck in the bay leaves.
Cover and cook on low for 8 to 10 hours, until it falls apart.
Take out the bay leaves and shred the beef in the juices with two forks.
Serve in tortillas with onion, cilantro and lime.

recipes.name: Birria tacos
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) beef chuck roast, cut in big chunks
2 cups (225 g) shredded Oaxaca or mozzarella cheese
steps: Pull the stems and seeds out of the chilies. Ask an adult to help.
Toast the chilies in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side, then soak in hot water for 15 minutes.
Blend the chilies, onion, garlic, tomatoes, vinegar, cumin and oregano with 1 cup of broth until smooth.
Put the beef, salt, sauce, the rest of the broth, cinnamon and bay leaves in a big pot. Bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 3 hours, until the beef falls apart. Shred the beef. The red broth is the consome.
Dip a tortilla in the fat on top of the consome and lay it in a hot pan over medium heat.
Add cheese and beef, fold, and cook for 2 minutes per side, until crispy. An adult should help with the hot pan.
Serve with cups of consome for dipping, plus onion, cilantro and lime.

recipes.name: Baja fish tacos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) cod, tilapia or mahi mahi, cut in strips
1/2 cup (115 g) sour cream or mayonnaise
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the fish with the spices, salt and oil and spread on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until it flakes easily and is 145°F (63°C).
Whisk the sour cream, juice of half the lime and hot sauce to make crema.
Toss the cabbage with the juice of the other half of the lime.
Warm the tortillas and fill with fish, cabbage, crema, avocado and cilantro.

recipes.name: Garlic lime shrimp tacos
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
Shredded cabbage, cilantro and chipotle mayo
steps: Chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the shrimp with the chili powder, paprika and salt.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and add the shrimp in one layer.
Cook for 1 to 2 minutes per side, until pink. Add the garlic for the last 30 seconds.
Squeeze the lime over the shrimp.
Fill warm tortillas with shrimp, avocado, cabbage, cilantro and chipotle mayo.

recipes.name: Pork al pastor tacos
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless pork shoulder, sliced 1/4 inch thick
3 dried guajillo chilies, stems and seeds removed
Corn tortillas, chopped onion, cilantro and lime
steps: Soak the chilies in hot water for 15 minutes, then drain.
Blend the chilies, pineapple juice, vinegar, achiote, garlic, cumin, oregano and salt until smooth.
Slice the pork thinly, ask an adult to help, and coat it in the marinade. Chill for 2 hours to overnight.
Heat the oil in a big heavy pan over medium-high heat and cook the pork in batches for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until charred and cooked through.
Chop the pork into small pieces.
Cook the pineapple chunks in the pan for 3 to 4 minutes, until browned.
Serve in tortillas with pineapple, onion, cilantro and lime.

recipes.name: Slow cooker salsa chicken
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
Tortillas, rice, cheese and toppings to serve
steps: Put the chicken in the slow cooker and sprinkle with the taco seasoning and salt.
Pour the salsa over the top.
Cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 hours, or high for 2 to 3 hours, until 165°F (74°C) and easy to shred.
Shred the chicken in the slow cooker with two forks and stir it into the sauce.
Use it for tacos, burritos, nachos or rice bowls.

recipes.name: Chiles rellenos
ingredients: 8 oz (225 g) Oaxaca or Monterey Jack cheese, cut in sticks
1 can (14.5 oz / 410 g) diced tomatoes, 1/4 onion and 1 garlic clove, for the sauce
steps: An adult roasts the poblanos directly over a gas flame or under the broiler for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until black all over.
Put them in a bowl, cover with a plate for 10 minutes, then rub off the skins.
Cut a slit down each pepper, scoop out the seeds and stuff with cheese. Close with a toothpick.
Blend the tomatoes, onion and garlic and simmer in a pot for 10 minutes for the sauce.
Beat the egg whites to stiff peaks, then fold in the yolks and salt.
An adult heats 1 inch of oil in a pan to 350°F (175°C).
Roll each pepper in flour, dip in the egg batter, and fry for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden. An adult should do the frying.
Drain on paper towels, take out the toothpicks, and serve with the tomato sauce.

recipes.name: Arroz con pollo
ingredients: 1 packet sazon seasoning or 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
1 1/2 cups (285 g) long grain white rice
steps: Season the chicken with 1 teaspoon salt, cumin and paprika. Wash your hands.
Chop the onion, pepper and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken skin side down for 5 minutes per side. Lift it out.
Cook the onion and pepper in the pot for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and sazon for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute, then add the tomato sauce, broth and the rest of the salt.
Nestle the chicken back in and bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low for 25 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Scatter the peas and olives on top, cover for 5 minutes, then fluff.

recipes.name: Baked chicken chimichangas
ingredients: Sour cream, guacamole and salsa to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mix the chicken, salsa, cumin and chili powder.
Warm the tortillas so they bend.
Spread beans down the middle of each, add chicken and cheese, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Lay seam side down on a baking sheet and brush all over with melted butter.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Serve with sour cream, guacamole and salsa.

recipes.name: Tamale pie
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz / 425 g) black beans, drained
1 box (8.5 oz / 240 g) corn muffin mix, plus 1 egg and 1/3 cup (80 ml) milk
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Chop the onion.
Cook the beef and onion in an oven-safe pan over medium heat for 8 minutes, until browned. Drain the fat.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, salt, tomatoes, beans and corn and simmer for 10 minutes.
Sprinkle the cheese on top.
Mix the muffin mix, egg and milk and spread it over the filling.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the cornbread is golden and a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.name: Cuban picadillo
ingredients: Cooked white rice and black beans to serve
steps: Chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook for 7 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Add the cumin, oregano, salt, tomato sauce, water, olives, raisins and potato.
Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Serve over rice with black beans.

recipes.name: Ropa vieja
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) flank steak or chuck roast
1 red and 1 green bell pepper, sliced
Cooked rice and fried plantains to serve
steps: Season the beef with salt.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef for 4 minutes per side. Lift it out.
Slice the onion and peppers. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the onion and peppers in the pot for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, olives, bay leaf and beef and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 2 hours 30 minutes, until the beef shreds easily.
Shred the beef in the pot with two forks and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes to thicken.
Serve over rice with plantains.

recipes.name: Cuban mojo roast pork
steps: Whisk the juices, oil, garlic, cumin, oregano, salt and pepper. This is mojo.
Poke the pork all over with a knife and put it in a bag with 3/4 of the mojo. Ask an adult to help. Marinate in the fridge overnight.
Heat the oven to 325°F (165°C).
Put the onion in a roasting pan and set the pork on top with its marinade.
Cover with foil and roast for 3 hours.
Uncover, turn the oven to 425°F (220°C) and roast for 30 to 45 minutes more, until browned and very tender, at least 190°F (88°C).
Rest for 15 minutes, shred or slice, and drizzle with the saved mojo.

recipes.name: Lomo saltado
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) beef sirloin, cut in thick strips
1 red onion, cut in thick wedges
1 aji amarillo or yellow chili, sliced (optional)
1 bag (16 oz / 450 g) frozen french fries, cooked
steps: Bake the fries as the bag says. Cut the beef and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Season the beef with salt, pepper and cumin.
Heat a wok or big pan over high heat until very hot and add 2 tablespoons oil.
Sear the beef in 2 batches for 1 to 2 minutes, until browned. Lift it out.
Add the rest of the oil and the onion, garlic and chili and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, soy sauce and vinegar and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef, cilantro and fries and toss quickly.
Serve right away with rice.

recipes.name: Peruvian roast chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken (4 lb / 1.8 kg), cut in half or spatchcocked
Green sauce: 1 cup cilantro, 1 jalapeno, 1/3 cup mayonnaise, 1 garlic clove, 2 tablespoons lime juice, 1/4 teaspoon salt
steps: An adult cuts out the backbone with kitchen shears and presses the chicken flat.
Mix the garlic, soy sauce, lime juice, oil and spices and rub it all over the chicken. Wash your hands.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Roast skin side up on a rack over a sheet pan for 45 to 55 minutes, until 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part of the thigh.
Blend the green sauce ingredients until smooth.
Rest the chicken for 10 minutes, cut into pieces, and serve with green sauce and fries.

recipes.name: Simple feijoada
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
1 lb (450 g) pork shoulder, cut in 1 inch cubes
12 oz (340 g) smoked sausage like linguica or kielbasa, sliced
Cooked white rice, orange slices and sauteed collard greens to serve
steps: Chop the bacon, pork, onion and garlic and slice the sausage. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in a big pot over medium heat for 6 minutes. Add the pork and brown for 6 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beans, sausage, bay leaves and water and bring to a boil.
Cover partly and simmer on low for 2 hours, stirring now and then, until the beans are creamy and the pork is tender.
Mash a ladle of beans and stir them back in to thicken. Add salt to taste.
Serve with rice, orange slices and greens.

recipes.name: Steak with chimichurri
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) flank, skirt or sirloin steak
1 cup (30 g) packed parsley, finely chopped
steps: Finely chop the parsley and garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the parsley, garlic, oregano, chili flakes, vinegar, olive oil and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes.
Season the steak with the rest of the salt and pepper.
Heat the vegetable oil in a heavy pan over high heat and cook the steak for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until 135°F (57°C) for medium.
Rest for 10 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain.
Spoon the chimichurri over the steak.

recipes.name: Milanesa breaded steak
ingredients: 4 thin beef cutlets (top round, about 1/4 inch thick)
steps: Pound the cutlets thin between plastic wrap if needed.
Beat the eggs with the garlic, parsley, salt and pepper and soak the cutlets in it for 10 minutes.
Press each cutlet into the breadcrumbs on both sides. Wash your hands.
An adult heats 1/4 inch of oil in a big pan over medium-high heat.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through. An adult should do the frying.
Drain on paper towels and serve with lemon wedges and mashed potatoes or salad.

recipes.name: Jamaican jerk chicken
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks
1 to 2 scotch bonnet peppers, seeded (wear gloves)
steps: Blend everything except the chicken into a smooth paste. Ask an adult to handle the scotch bonnets with gloves.
Cut 2 slashes in each chicken piece and coat it in the paste. Wash your hands.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Lay the chicken on a rack over a foil-lined pan.
Roast for 35 to 45 minutes, until charred in spots and 165°F (74°C) inside.
Serve with rice and peas and fried plantains.

recipes.name: Jamaican curry chicken
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken pieces, cut small
1 whole scotch bonnet pepper (don't cut it)
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the chicken with 2 tablespoons curry powder, salt, allspice, onion, garlic, green onions, ginger and thyme. Marinate for 30 minutes. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and stir in the rest of the curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the chicken, leaving the onions behind for now, and brown for 5 minutes.
Add the onions, potatoes, water and scotch bonnet and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 35 to 40 minutes, until the chicken is tender and 165°F (74°C) and the sauce is thick.
Take out the scotch bonnet and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Jamaican brown stew chicken
steps: Slice and chop the vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, seasoning and browning sauce. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken for 4 minutes per side. Lift it out.
Add the onion, pepper, garlic, green onions and thyme and cook for 4 minutes.
Stir in the brown sugar, ketchup and water.
Put the chicken back, cover and simmer for 35 to 40 minutes, until 165°F (74°C) and the gravy is thick.
Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.name: Jamaican oxtail stew
ingredients: 4 cups (960 ml) water or beef broth
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) butter beans, drained
steps: Season the oxtails with salt, pepper, browning, soy sauce, onion, garlic, green onions and ginger. Marinate for 1 hour or overnight. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the oxtails for 3 to 4 minutes per side, leaving the onions in the bowl. Ask an adult to help.
Add the onions, brown sugar, allspice, thyme, water and scotch bonnet and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 2 hours 30 minutes to 3 hours, adding water if needed, until the meat falls off the bone.
Add the butter beans and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes, until the gravy is thick.
Take out the scotch bonnet and thyme stems and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Trinidad pelau
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in pieces
2 tablespoons green seasoning or chopped herbs and garlic
1 can (15 oz / 425 g) pigeon peas, drained
steps: Season the chicken with salt and green seasoning. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil and sugar in a big heavy pot over medium heat, without stirring, until the sugar melts and turns dark amber, about 3 to 4 minutes. An adult should do this, melted sugar is very hot.
Carefully add the chicken and stir to coat it in the caramel. Cook for 6 minutes.
Add the onion and carrot and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the rice, pigeon peas, coconut milk, water, ketchup and scotch bonnet and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 25 to 30 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Take out the scotch bonnet and fluff.

recipes.name: Jollof rice
ingredients: 2 cups (380 g) long grain parboiled rice, rinsed
Fried or roasted chicken to serve
steps: Blend the tomatoes, peppers, chopped onion and scotch bonnet until smooth.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the sliced onion for 4 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Add the tomato paste and fry for 3 minutes, stirring.
Add the blended sauce, curry powder, thyme and bay leaves and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes, until thick and the oil rises to the top.
Stir in the rice, broth and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover tightly with foil and the lid and cook on low for 25 to 30 minutes, until the rice is tender. Don't stir.
Take out the bay leaves, fluff and serve with chicken.

recipes.name: Nigerian beef suya
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) sirloin or flank steak, sliced very thin
1/2 cup (75 g) roasted peanuts, finely ground (or 3 tablespoons peanut butter powder)
Sliced red onion and tomato to serve
steps: Mix the peanuts, spices, salt and bouillon to make yaji spice.
Slice the beef thinly, ask an adult to help, and thread it onto skewers.
Brush the beef with oil and press the spice mix all over it. Let it sit for 30 minutes.
Heat the broiler or grill to high.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through. An adult should do the grilling.
Sprinkle with more spice and serve with onion and tomato.

recipes.name: Maafe West African peanut stew
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks
steps: Chop the vegetables and chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Season the chicken with salt and brown it in the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat for 6 minutes. Lift it out.
Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and broth and whisk in the peanut butter until smooth.
Add the chicken, sweet potato, carrots and cayenne and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring now and then, until the vegetables are soft and the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Moroccan chicken tagine
ingredients: 1 preserved lemon, rinsed and sliced, or zest and juice of 1 lemon
steps: Season the chicken with salt. Slice the onions and chop the garlic. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot or tagine over medium-high heat and brown the chicken skin side down for 6 minutes. Lift it out.
Cook the onions for 8 minutes, until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the broth and chicken and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low for 35 minutes.
Add the lemon and olives and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C) and the sauce thickens.
Top with herbs and serve with couscous.

recipes.name: Doro wat Ethiopian chicken stew
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken drumsticks and thighs, skin removed
1/3 cup (75 g) niter kibbeh or butter
steps: Rub the chicken with lemon juice and salt. Wash your hands.
Finely chop the onions. Ask an adult to help, there are a lot.
Cook the onions in a dry heavy pot over medium-low heat for 20 minutes, stirring often, until soft and jammy. Don't let them burn.
Add the butter, garlic, ginger and berbere and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and broth.
Add the chicken and simmer covered for 45 minutes, stirring now and then.
Cut shallow slits in the eggs and add them to the stew.
Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes more, until the chicken is tender and 165°F (74°C) and the sauce is thick. Serve with injera.

recipes.name: Misir wot spiced red lentils
ingredients: 4 cups (960 ml) water or vegetable broth
steps: Finely chop the onions. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the onions in the butter in a pot over medium heat for 10 minutes, until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, berbere and tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the lentils and water and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring often, until the lentils break down and it's thick.
Add the salt and serve with injera or rice.

recipes.name: Bobotie
ingredients: 3 tablespoons fruit chutney or apricot jam
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Soak the bread in half the milk.
Chop the onion and garlic and cook them in the oil in a big pan over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and cook for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Stir in the curry powder, turmeric, salt, chutney, raisins, lemon juice and the squeezed-out bread.
Spread in a baking dish.
Whisk the eggs with the rest of the milk and the soaking milk and pour it over the top. Lay the bay leaves on top.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the custard is set and golden. Serve with yellow rice.

recipes.name: Red red Ghanaian bean stew
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) red palm oil or vegetable oil with 1 teaspoon paprika
2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) black-eyed peas, drained
3 ripe plantains, sliced and fried, to serve
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and scotch bonnet for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, then add the tomatoes.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the black-eyed peas, broth and salt and simmer for 15 minutes, until thick.
Serve with fried sweet plantains.

recipes.name: Senegalese chicken yassa
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks
steps: Slice the onions thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the onions, lemon juice, mustard, garlic, salt and pepper and add the chicken. Marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium-high heat. Lift the chicken out of the onions and brown it for 4 minutes per side. Lift it out.
Add the onions and marinade and cook for 15 minutes, stirring, until soft and golden.
Add the broth, chicken and whole scotch bonnet.
Cover and simmer for 35 minutes, until the chicken is 165°F (74°C).
Add the olives and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Kenyan beef pilau
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) beef chuck, cut in small cubes
4 cups (960 ml) water, plus more as needed
2 teaspoons pilau masala, or 1 teaspoon cumin plus 1/2 teaspoon each cinnamon, cardamom and black pepper
steps: Simmer the beef in the water for 45 minutes, until tender. Keep the broth.
Slice the onions and chop the garlic and tomatoes. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onions for 10 minutes, until deep brown.
Add the garlic, ginger and pilau masala for 1 minute.
Add the beef and tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir, then add 3 cups of the beef broth and the salt.
Bring to a boil, cover and cook on low for 18 to 20 minutes, until the rice is tender. Rest for 5 minutes and fluff.

recipes.name: Koshari
steps: Slice the onions thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Fry the onions in the oil over medium-high heat for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring, until dark and crispy. Drain on paper towels and keep the oil.
Simmer the lentils in water for 20 minutes, until tender. Drain.
Cook the rice in 2 cups of water, 1 tablespoon of the onion oil and 1 teaspoon salt, covered on low for 18 minutes.
Boil the macaroni as the package says and drain.
Cook the garlic in 2 tablespoons of the onion oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes, vinegar, cumin, chili flakes and the rest of the salt, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Layer rice, lentils, pasta and chickpeas in bowls, spoon the tomato sauce over, and top with crispy onions.

recipes.name: Peri peri chicken
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks
2 to 4 red chilies or 1 roasted red pepper for mild
steps: Blend everything except the chicken into a smooth sauce. Ask an adult to help with the chilies.
Cut slashes in the chicken and coat it in half the sauce. Keep the rest in the fridge. Wash your hands.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Roast on a rack over a foil-lined pan for 35 to 45 minutes, until charred in spots and 165°F (74°C) inside.
Brush with the saved sauce for the last 5 minutes.
Serve with rice, fries or salad.

recipes.name: Moroccan vegetable couscous
ingredients: 2 cups (280 g) butternut squash, in chunks
1 1/2 cups (270 g) couscous, 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) boiling water and 1 tablespoon butter
steps: Cut the vegetables. Ask an adult to help, the squash is hard.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, carrots and squash and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the zucchini, chickpeas, raisins and salt and simmer for 10 minutes, until tender.
Put the couscous and butter in a bowl, pour the boiling water over, cover and let it sit for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Pile couscous on plates and ladle the vegetables and broth over it.

recipes.name: Easy chicken mole
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) bone-in chicken thighs and drumsticks
1 jar (8 oz / 235 g) mole paste, like Dona Maria
3 cups (720 ml) chicken broth from cooking the chicken
1 oz (30 g) Mexican chocolate or dark chocolate (optional)
Toasted sesame seeds, rice and warm tortillas to serve
steps: Put the chicken, onion, garlic and salt in a pot, cover with water and simmer for 30 minutes, until 165°F (74°C). Keep the broth.
Spoon the mole paste into a big pan over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Slowly whisk in the broth a little at a time until smooth.
Add the chocolate and sugar and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring, until thick like gravy.
Add the chicken and simmer for 5 minutes, spooning sauce over it.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with rice and tortillas.
